title: US Benefits specialist
description:
Orion Innovation is a premier, award\-winning, global business and technology services firm. Orion delivers game\-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity. We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education.

**Job Overview:**



The US Benefits Specialist will support the administration, governance, and continuous improvement of employee benefits programs in the United States. The role will ensure accurate and timely benefits administration across the employee lifecycle while partnering with HR, Payroll, Finance, employees, benefits vendors, and brokers. The role will also support benefits compliance, reporting, employee communication, and data integrity.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Administer US employee benefits programs including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, retirement/401(k), FSA/HSA and other company\-sponsored benefits.
* Manage day\-to\-day benefits activities across new hires, qualifying life events, status changes, leaves, terminations, and other employee lifecycle events.
* Coordinate annual benefits open enrollment activities including plan setup, eligibility validation, employee communications, enrollment support, and reconciliation.
* Partner with Payroll and HR Operations to ensure accurate benefits deductions, employer contributions, eligibility, and payroll integration.
* Coordinate with benefits brokers, carriers, third\-party administrators, and other vendors to resolve employee issues and ensure service delivery.
* Monitor benefits eligibility and enrollment data, identify discrepancies, and drive timely corrections.
* Support administration and reconciliation of 401(k), HSA, FSA, COBRA, life and disability benefits and other applicable US benefit programs.
* Support benefits\-related compliance activities, documentation, audits, filings, and recordkeeping in partnership with internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare benefits reports, dashboards, reconciliations, and management insights covering enrollment, participation, costs, utilization, and vendor performance.
* Support benefits cost analysis, renewal activities, plan comparisons, and data preparation for annual benefits planning.
* Develop and maintain employee\-facing benefits communications, FAQs, guides, and process documentation.
* Act as a subject\-matter resource for employees and HR stakeholders on US benefits policies, eligibility, enrollment, and issue resolution.
* Maintain accurate and confidential benefits records, controls, documentation, and auditready approvals in HR systems.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve the US benefits experience and administration processes.


**Key Skills:**


* Strong knowledge of US benefits processes, terminology, and administration practices.
* Advanced Excel skills with strong capability in data analysis, reconciliation, validation, and reporting.
* Experience with HRIS and benefits administration systems; exposure to HR analytics or reporting tools is preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage confidential employee and benefits information.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with employees, HR, Payroll, Finance, vendors, brokers, and leadership.
* Strong problem\-solving, follow\-through, organization, and process\-improvement mindset.
* Ability to work independently in a global HR environment while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in US Benefits, Total Rewards, HR Operations, or Benefits Administration.
* Hands\-on experience administering US employee benefits programs and managing employee benefits queries and lifecycle events.
* Strong understanding of US benefits administration, including health and welfare benefits, 401(k), HSA/FSA, COBRA, life and disability programs.
* Experience working with benefits brokers, carriers, third\-party administrators, and benefits technology platforms.
* Experience supporting open enrollment, benefits reconciliations, audits, reporting, and vendor management.


Orion is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.



Candidate Privacy Policy

* What information we collect during our application and recruitment process and why we collect it;

Your use of Orion services is governed by any applicable terms in this notice and our general Privacy Policy.

title: Senior HR Executive
description:
We are looking for **male candidates** responsible and organized **HR \& Administration Executive** to manage day\-to\-day HR and administrative activities at our automobile dealership.

The ideal candidate should have a minimum of **1 to 2 years of experience in HR**, preferably in a **car showroom, automobile dealership, or related industry**. The candidate will be responsible for recruitment, employee records, attendance, payroll coordination, employee engagement, office administration, and ensuring smooth day\-to\-day administrative operations.

Key HR Responsibilities

* Handle **end\-to\-end recruitment** for Sales, Service, Customer Relations, Technicians, Drivers, and other dealership positions.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media, references, walk\-ins, and other recruitment channels.
* Coordinate interviews, selection, reference checks, and joining formalities.
* Maintain updated **employee personal files, HR records, and HR databases**.
* Manage employee **attendance, leave, late\-coming, absenteeism, and shift records**.
* Handle employee joining, confirmation, transfer, promotion, resignation, and exit formalities.
* Prepare and maintain HR reports related to manpower, attendance, recruitment, leave, and employee productivity.
* Address employee queries and coordinate with department heads for resolution of HR\-related matters.
* Coordinate employee training, induction, meetings, and engagement activities.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information.
* Assist in ensuring compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.

Key Administration Responsibilities

* Manage the **day\-to\-day administrative activities** of the showroom.
* Coordinate office requirements including **stationery, housekeeping, security, pantry, uniforms, and other facility requirements**.
* Maintain records of administrative expenses, office supplies, assets, and equipment.
* Coordinate with vendors, service providers, housekeeping, security, maintenance, and other external agencies.
* Monitor the cleanliness, maintenance, and general upkeep of the showroom and office premises.
* Coordinate repairs and maintenance of office equipment, furniture, electrical systems, ACs, and other facilities.
* Ensure adequate availability of **stationery, printing materials, employee uniforms, ID cards, and other office requirements**.
* Maintain records of company assets and assist in **asset allocation and tracking**.
* Coordinate official correspondence, courier, documentation, and other administrative requirements.
* Assist management in organizing **meetings, events, employee activities, and dealership functions**.
* Maintain proper administrative files, registers, records, and documentation.
* Coordinate with various departments to ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations.
* Monitor and follow up on administrative service contracts and vendor requirements.
* Assist management in implementing company rules, procedures, and workplace discipline.
* Handle any other HR and administrative responsibilities assigned by management.

Required Skills

* Good **communication and interpersonal skills**.
* Strong organizational and coordination abilities.
* Good knowledge of **HR and administrative procedures**.
* Working knowledge of **MS Office, especially MS Excel and Word**.
* Ability to maintain accurate records and prepare reports.
* Good employee\-handling and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments, vendors, and service providers.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.
* Professional attitude and ability to work in a fast\-paced automobile dealership environment.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Minimum **1 year of experience in HR \& Administration**.
* Experience in a **car dealership, automobile company, automotive workshop, or similar organization** will be preferred.
* Should have practical knowledge of **recruitment, attendance, payroll coordination, employee documentation, and administration**.
* Should be proactive, well\-organized, and capable of independently handling routine HR \& administrative activities.

Pay: From ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: COO - Club Oxygen
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic **Head of Hospitality** to lead and oversee the Group's hospitality business with complete responsibility for **business performance, operations, profitability, people, customer experience, expansion, and strategic growth**.

The ideal candidate should have strong **CEO / COO / Business Head / General Management experience**, with the ability to manage complex operations, build high\-performing teams, improve business performance, and drive sustainable growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide overall strategic and operational leadership for the hospitality division.
* Take ownership of **revenue, profitability, cost control, service quality, and business growth**.
* Develop and execute short\-term and long\-term business strategies.
* Oversee hospitality properties, restaurants, resorts, and related operations.
* Establish systems, processes, SOPs, and performance standards across operations.
* Identify opportunities for **business expansion, new properties, new concepts, and strategic partnerships**.
* Monitor financial performance, budgets, cash flows, margins, and operational costs.
* Build, develop, and retain strong leadership teams across functions.
* Establish performance\-driven management systems and accountability at all levels.
* Drive customer experience, service standards, brand positioning, and guest satisfaction.
* Work closely with Finance, HR, Marketing, Projects, Procurement, and other corporate functions.
* Review business performance through regular MIS, KPIs, and management reports and take corrective actions where required.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and implement measures to improve productivity and profitability.
* Represent the hospitality business before key stakeholders, partners, vendors, and external agencies.
* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory, regulatory, safety, and operational requirements.
* Act as a strategic advisor to Group Management on hospitality investments, opportunities, and business decisions.

**Candidate Profile**

* **15\+ years of overall professional experience**, with significant experience in senior leadership roles.
* Experience as **CEO, COO, Business Head, Executive Director, General Manager, or equivalent senior management position** is preferred.
* Candidates with experience across **multiple industries**, particularly hospitality, retail, FMCG, services, tourism, real estate, or other consumer\-facing businesses, may be considered.
* Strong understanding of **P\&L management, business strategy, operations, people management, sales, and commercial decision\-making**.
* Proven experience managing large teams and multi\-unit / multi\-location operations.
* Strong leadership, negotiation, communication, analytical, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to operate at both **strategic and execution levels**.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong focus on business growth and profitability.
* Graduate degree is required; **MBA / equivalent management qualification is preferred**.

Work Location: In person
